title: oenothera capillifolia subsp. berlandieri
intro: Oenothera capillifolia subsp. berlandieri, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Onagraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which is an essential fatty acid with potent anti-inflammatory properties. Regular consumption of Evening Primrose has been linked to improved symptoms of menopausal hot flashes and other conditions related to hormonal imbalances.
